assets.name: arghast-drawer
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Painted fantasy RPG encyclopedia illustration, rich atmospheric brushwork, exquisite aged materials, no text, no letters, no logo, no UI, no people. Decorative atmosphere rather than canonical geography. Asset: portrait 9:16 background for a narrow navigation drawer for Arghast, a fantasy world. Neutral charcoal stone, muted antique brass and warm gray. Ancient stone archive alcove with a beautifully crafted brass armillary sphere and worn books toward the bottom; carved stone framing along edges, deep quiet smoky charcoal negative space through upper and middle central area for overlaid navigation. Subtle golden light, mysterious, tactile, restrained neutral palette. No maps. Full bleed vertical artwork.
